findings.summary: RegExp semantic fixtures use the shared runGeneratedProgram native harness.
RegExp lastIndex reads have one owner in native data property lowering.
Descriptor callbacks use the shared isSupportedFunction predicate.
Validated descriptor members use a discriminated union, so emission requires no repeated AST validation.
Void and undefined comparisons share operand normalization and absence comparison, preserving evaluation order.
Discarded async returns share a value-aware completion boundary before effects are emitted.
